The *Kilesavippayuttasaṁkilesikaduka* is an Abhidhamma treatise located in the *Dukapaṭṭhāna* division of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Pali Tipiṭaka. The text analyzes the system of twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) as applied to the dyad (*duka*) of mental and material phenomena that are dissociated from defilements (*kilesavippayutta*) yet remain subject to defilement (*saṁkilesika*) [DharmaNexus].

 However, DharmaNexus records substantial Pali-internal text reuse characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna*'s combinatorial matrices, documenting 144 matching passages shared across 34 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus].
